description: Calculate the total landed cost for a product being shipped internationally. Returns a detailed breakdown of import duties, VAT/GST, customs fees, and the final total price the buyer will pay. Supports 240 countries and territories. Includes China CBEC tax, Mexico IEPS, Brazil cascading tax, India IGST, and processing fees for 12 countries. When providing productName for auto-classification, include material for accurate HS code results.

composition.description: Material composition. Example: '100% cotton', '70% polyester 30% cotton'

destinationCountry.description: Destination country as 2-letter ISO code. Examples: US, GB, DE, CA, AU, JP, FR, KR

hsCode.description: If known, the HS Code for precise duty calculation. Example: 6109.10 (cotton t-shirts)

material.description: Primary material — needed for accurate HS classification. Examples: cotton, leather, steel, polyester, rubber

origin.description: Origin country as 2-letter ISO code. Examples: CN (China), DE (Germany), JP (Japan), IT (Italy), GB (United Kingdom)

processing.description: Manufacturing/processing method. Examples: woven, knitted, forged, molded

productCategory.description: Product category for classification. Examples: electronics, apparel, footwear, accessories, food

productName.description: Name of the product for automatic HS Code classification. Examples: Cotton T-Shirt, Laptop, Running Shoes

shippingPrice.description: Shipping cost in USD. Default: 0. Example: 8.50

zipcode.description: Destination ZIP/postal code. Recommended for US destinations to calculate state sales tax. Example: 10001 (New York), 90210 (Beverly Hills)

name: calculate_landed_cost
